title: Recruitment Trainee / Staffing Associate
description:
**🚀 We're Hiring: Recruitment Trainee / Staffing Associate** 




  





 📍
 **Location:** 
 Banjara Hills, Hyderabad (Onsite)
 



 🕒
 **Shift:** 
 6:00 PM \- 3:00 AM IST
 



 🎯
 **Openings:** 
 10\+
 



 👨 🎓
 **Experience:** 
 Freshers \| Interns \| Recent Graduates Welcome
 



  





 Looking to kickstart your career in the exciting world of
 **Recruitment \& Staffing** 
 ?
 



  





**Lemora Global** 
 is growing rapidly and we're looking for enthusiastic, career\-driven individuals who want to learn the recruiting industry from the ground up. If you're proactive, eager to learn, and possess strong communication skills, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.
 



  





**What You'll Learn \& Do:** 




  





 ✅ Candidate sourcing and talent identification
 



 ✅ Resume screening and candidate evaluation
 



 ✅ Working with leading job portals and recruitment platforms
 



 ✅ Professional communication with candidates and hiring teams
 



 ✅ End\-to\-end recruitment process fundamentals
 



 ✅ Building long\-term skills in staffing, recruiting, and talent acquisition
 



  





**What We're Looking For:** 




  





 ✔ Fresh graduates, interns, or entry\-level professionals
 



 ✔ Strong verbal and written communication skills
 



 ✔ Positive attitude and willingness to learn
 



 ✔ Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
 



 ✔ Able to work onsite in Hyderabad
 



 ✔ Available to work the 6:00 PM \- 3:00 AM IST shift
 



 ✔ Strong interest in Human Resources, Recruitment, or Staffing
 



  





**What We Offer:** 




  





 💰 Competitive salary package
 



 💸 Performance\-based incentives
 



 📚 Hands\-on recruitment training
 



 🌟 Industry exposure and mentorship
 



 📈 Clear career growth opportunities
 



 🤝 Opportunity to grow within a fast\-growing staffing organization
 



  





**Walk\-In Interviews** 




  





 📅 Starting:
 **September 10, 2026** 




 ⏰ Time:
 **9:00 PM IST** 




  





 📍
 **Office Address:** 




 SSK Building, 1st Floor
 



 Ranga Raju Lane, Road No. 1
 



 Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana 500034
 



  





 📧
 **Apply/Contact:** 
 Mason.gray@lemoraglobal.com
 



  





 If you're looking to build a long\-term career in recruitment and gain hands\-on experience in the staffing industry, we'd love to meet you!
